concept: Compute Savings Plan: flexible discount for a steady baseline
tests: Choosing a commitment for a steady 24/7 baseline across multiple families, Regions, and Fargate.
expected: Compute Savings Plan — a $/hour commitment across any families, sizes, Regions, Fargate/Lambda. Triggers: "steady 24/7 baseline", "multiple families and Regions", "plus Fargate", "deepest savings + maximum flexibility".
why_not: Standard RIs are tied to type/Region; Spot is for interruptible workloads; On-Demand Capacity Reservations guarantee capacity but give no discount.
